# Support

Where to ask about Knightwatcher, and what to expect.

The [documentation](https://knightwatcher.io/docs/) covers installing, configuring and running
Knightwatcher, and making packs. Most questions are answered there, and searching the
[issues](https://github.com/knightwatcher-io/knightwatcher/issues) first often finds the rest.

- **Questions:** ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/knightwatcher-io/knightwatcher/discussions),
  under Q&A.
- **Ideas:** share them in Discussions, under Ideas. Show your wall is for photos of yours, and
  Announcements carries the releases and other news.
- **Bugs:** open a bug report through the
  [issue forms](https://github.com/knightwatcher-io/knightwatcher/issues/new/choose).
- **A service the collector should read:** open a provider request through the same forms.
- **Vulnerabilities:** report them privately, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) says, never in an
  issue or a discussion.

Knightwatcher is maintained by one person, on a best-effort basis. Every report and pull request
is read, but there is no promised response time.
